links.name: mechanism
links.state_rule: Not covered without a compound-specific measured mechanism validation.

links.name: target
links.state_rule: Not covered without measured intended-target engagement or validation for this parent.

links.name: activity
links.state_rule: Measured for admitted exact AC50, EC50 or IC50 response-potency points; otherwise absent.

links.name: selectivity
links.state_rule: Measured only for one admitted CYP3A4 and one CYP2D6 IC50 from the same document, each based on one activity; otherwise absent. The scope is these CYP enzymes, not intended-target selectivity.

links.name: exposure
links.state_rule: Measured only as in vitro intrinsic clearance in a named assay system; otherwise absent. It does not establish systemic exposure.

links.name: safety
links.state_rule: Not covered for these parents. The safety teaching cases are constructed and cannot be joined to them.

links.name: synthesis
links.state_rule: Not covered for these parents. Constructed route recovery is not a measured synthesis or feasibility result.

links.name: reproducibility
links.state_rule: Not covered without independent replication of this compound's chain; repeated rows or a rerun of this audit do not supply it.

counted_unit.name: one ChEMBL parent molecule's eight-link chain
counted_unit.join_rule: Use only equal parent_molecule_chembl_id from the three validated measured readers. Constructed records have no join to these parents.

rules.claim_gate: A chain supports a claim only when every link is measured. An absent, constructed or not covered link stops the claim, even when later links have measurements.
rules.claim_scope: A claim may not exceed the first measured link's own scope. A supported chain carries exactly that scope.

excluded_by_design: any claim that a chain makes a compound a development candidate
any ranking of compounds by how far their chains reach
any use of a constructed link as if it were measured
any claim of validated mechanism, intended-target engagement, systemic exposure, safety, synthesis feasibility or clinical outcome
any default, class mean or literature value substituted for an absent compound measurement
